## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (added/updated handler tests for any new or changed tool)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds; no duplicate tool names
- [ ] For new tools: request shapes checked against the App Store Connect OpenAPI spec, and anything still inferred is flagged `[VERIFY]` in the source
- [ ] README tool table + count and CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` updated
